headline: Blessina Kumar: receives first Union Community Champion Award for TB
dek: The International Union Against Tuberculosis and Lung Disease said it presented the inaugural award at #UnionConf2026, recognising Kumar's work championing the voices of TB survivors.
body:
The International Union Against Tuberculosis and Lung Disease (The Union) has presented Blessina Kumar with the first-ever Union Community Champion Award for TB. The organisation announced the award in a LinkedIn post about #UnionConf2026.

According to The Union, Kumar was recognised for her "outstanding contribution to championing the voices of TB survivors worldwide". The organisation described the presentation as "a special moment" at the conference.

The Union said Kumar is the founder of the Global Coalition of TB Advocates. It added that, through this work, she has helped ensure that lived experiences inform research.

The Union said the award is supported by the Indonesian Respiratory Programmatic Implementation and Research Institute.
key_quote: recognised for her outstanding contribution to championing the voices of TB survivors worldwide
